issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED may not exist on upstream SDK enum, causing AttributeError at init
issues.detail: _enable_vad checks EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED but only TurnDetectionMode.FIXED is added locally. EndOfUtteranceMode comes from speechmatics SDK 0.0.99; if FIXED isn't a member there, every instantiation raises AttributeError. Verify the SDK exposes this enum value or add a getattr guard, and pin the minimum speechmatics package version.

issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode change from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a silent breaking change
issues.detail: Existing users relying on the default EXTERNAL behavior will silently get different endpointing semantics on upgrade, potentially breaking interruption and turn behavior in production. This needs an explicit breaking-change changelog entry (currently only in .fixed.md) and migration guidance, ideally gated by a version bump.

issues.description: Switch to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame drops finalization for non-VAD pipelines
issues.detail: process_frame now finalizes only on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame instead of UserStoppedSpeakingFrame. Pipelines that emit UserStoppedSpeakingFrame from non-VAD sources (push-to-talk, manual triggers, smart-turn endpointers) will no longer trigger client.finalize(), leaving transcripts unfinalized. Handle both frame types or document the VAD requirement.

issues.description: speech_segment_config is unconditionally overwritten, clobbering user/preset config
issues.detail: config.speech_segment_config = SpeechSegmentConfig(emit_sentences=params.split_sentences or False) runs every time, discarding any other fields set upstream and forcing emit_sentences=False when the param is None. Only set when split_sentences is not None, or merge onto the existing config.

issues.description: Warning log fires on expected VAD frames, creating noise
issues.detail: The warning 'VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame received but internal VAD is being used' will fire on every turn when internal VAD is enabled, which is the expected pipeline behavior, not a misconfiguration. Downgrade to debug or remove.

issues.description: Commented-out start_processing_metrics call moved but not removed
issues.detail: In _handle_start_of_turn the `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` line was relocated rather than deleted or wired up. Dead commented code should either be enabled with intent or removed; shuffling it obscures intent and creates noise in future diffs.

synthesis.summary: The PR updates SpeechmaticsSTTService for SDK 0.0.99 with three high-risk changes: a possibly-nonexistent EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED reference that could AttributeError at instantiation, a silent default change from EXTERNAL to FIXED, and a narrowed finalization trigger (VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame only) that breaks non-VAD pipelines. The unconditional overwrite of speech_segment_config also risks clobbering user configuration. Smaller cleanups around a noisy warning log and dead commented metrics code should be addressed. The PR needs a breaking-change changelog entry, SDK enum verification, and broader finalization frame handling before merge.
